messages:
nina: Quick question 'fyi' - hitting a bundler interop where named exports from the JS SDK end up on `.default` only when deployed to edge. Local dev + node OK.

hiro: Which bundler and build flow?

nina: Rollup for the edge bundle (format: es) + @rollup/plugin-commonjs. App sets "type":"module". Import is `import { RedwoodClient } from '@redwood/inference'` -> runtime prints `undefined`.

sam: Sounds like CJS -> ESM wrapping. Check package.json exports and whether dist/cjs sets `exports.RedwoodClient` vs `module.exports = { RedwoodClient }`. Also Vite optimizeDeps can prebundle CJS into ESM and change shapes.

nina: package.json: `{ "main":"dist/cjs/index.js","module":"dist/esm/index.js","exports":{"import":"./dist/esm/index.js","require":"./dist/cjs/index.js"},"types":"dist/types/index.d.ts" }`

hiro: Two immediate app-workarounds: 1) force ESM path `import('@redwood/inference/dist/esm/index.js')`, 2) in vite.config `ssr:{ noExternal:['@redwood/inference'] }`. Both stop the prebundle path.

sam: For library fix: ship proper ESM with named exports + a default that re-exports same symbol. Also update d.ts to `export class RedwoodClient{} export default RedwoodClient;`. Add CI smoke test that bundles with rollup, webpack, and vite-ssr.

nina: TS types complaint is real: switching to default import resolves runtime but breaks typecheck. Ugly to force consumers to change.

hiro: Quick repro idea: tiny package that only publishes CJS, then a vite-ssr app that imports named export -> shows `console.log()` of module shape. Easy to include in issue.

sam: Add checklist in SDK issue: explicit exports map for "." with import/require, ensure ESM build uses named exports, include default export shim, update types, add bundler smoke tests.

devex-bot: Reminder: drop the repro link in the issue and tag sdk-maintainers.

nina: Will file issue with repro + minimal rollup config. Posting snippet:```js
// rollup.config.js
import resolve from '@rollup/plugin-node-resolve';
import commonjs from '@rollup/plugin-commonjs';
export default { input:'src/index.js', output:{file:'dist/bundle.js',format:'es'}, plugins:[resolve({browser:true}), commonjs({transformMixedEsModules:true})] }
```
If `console.log(RedwoodClient)` prints `undefined`, it's the interop bug.
